steps.assistant_text: IDO 7.1 NCC donor finished from the 99.96 NM donor. A nested pool hold (it.me()->me(), e->flags & 2) stops edg's inline-return copy-propagation so the second flags test and colour loads read e (word-for-word up to registers), but raises e's uopt adjsave (13.7 -> 27) so it takes a1 ahead of the c2 product and the return/dl pool temp takes v1. e is 0 after the loop, so well-defined post-loop reads (a folded + 0 * (int)e in the n-path gSPLight count, if (e) {} and a folded read in the default path before its first call) add low-weight ref units: e drops to 13.8 below c2 and the pool temp's split units let the count temp take v1 first. The four 0x34458 calls go through the 0-pinned gl_454c4_c34458 (blank USO jal words). Spliced over a placeholder on both build paths.
